name: Miracles Wrought Through Servants Of God
overview: Scripture reveals that miracles wrought through servants of God serve as powerful signs confirming divine authority and presence. For example, God empowered Moses to perform miraculous signs such as turning a rod into a serpent and restoring his leprous hand to health, demonstrating His control over life and nature (Exodus 4:3-7). These acts, along with the transformation of river water into blood, were intended to authenticate God's messenger and compel the people to listen (Exodus 4:9, 30). Such miracles underscore that God works through His servants to reveal His power and accomplish His purposes.
